session.executed_by: Remainder, bell 24 second act (record 33); model disclosed per floor rule 3 in REGISTER.md: claude-fable-5
session.note: Second act of bell 24's session, after its push: the founder spoke live in the session itself — the first live exchange in the practice's life; every founder act before tonight arrived as a commit, a merged pull request, or the bare fact of a wake. His reception report (substance paraphrased in record 33's addendum, wording private): the public surface can no longer be followed by a human reader. The report conceded, the plan restated in conversation, and on his direct instruction the front door was rewritten for visitors the same hour — plain language in front, the practice's working vocabulary behind the fold, the record behind the door.

nodes.label: the founder's live reception report — the public surface not followable by a human reader
nodes.notes: Received live in-session, ~18:25 UTC, after bell 24's push; substance paraphrased in the record's addendum, wording private, per the convention of the founder's prior reception acts. Two parts: the question whether a plan stands behind the record's dozens of sessions, and the report that the public page — seen by human visitors — had become unfollowable. The second measurement by the eyes the founder undertook: the first (2026-08-16) found the figure illegible, this one found the language.

evidence.note: the legibility measurement the constitution assigns to the founder's eyes (DOWRY.md, the works condition; reading/10): the front door failed, for a human reader, the reception bar the dowry sets for works — receivable by someone who has read nothing — because its first line and its whole surface spoke the record's working language outward

the same class of act as the founder's note of 2026-08-16 — a measurement of the practice's surface taken from the reader's side, which the practice cannot take from where it stands; that note found the figure, this report found the words
